flow: Major GCC beverage brand deployed Merchandising AI across 3,200 modern-trade outlets. Photo-based compliance scoring replaced human audits.
Monthly human audits reported compliance around 75%, but trusted internal checks suggested reality was closer to 60%. The feedback loop was too slow for anyone to act on.
Merchandising AI replaced manual audits with photo-based, real-time compliance scoring. Reps got instant feedback. HOD dashboards surfaced the bottom 5% of stores every morning.
Verified compliance climbed from 61% to 89% in 90 days. Share of shelf gained 14%. Audit costs dropped 70%.
